title: WF03 IDN-02 integration blocker: API-09 TC-API-09-INT-05 depended on token-gated trace harness preconditions

root_cause.description: TC-API-09-INT-05 did not enforce the same BPM_TEST_TOKEN precondition used by the other API-09 HTTP integration tests, so in partially configured harnesses it attempted live HTTP execution and surfaced connection/token dependency noise as a blocker.

resolution.summary: Applied the minimal test-harness fix in tests/integration/trace_test.zig by requiring BPM_TEST_TOKEN in TC-API-09-INT-05, aligning preconditions with the rest of the trace integration suite while preserving unauthenticated request behavior (no Authorization header).

actions: Keep environment precondition handling consistent across tests in the same integration file to avoid partial-configuration false blockers.
For unauthenticated-path tests, gate only setup prerequisites and keep the request itself unauthenticated to preserve behavioral intent.
